# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.6

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.6 improves the landing page and interactive plot on phones without changing
desktop sizing or navigation.

On screens up to 760 pixels wide, the animated ModDotPlot Browser logo now uses the
same width as the FASTA drop area. It remains horizontally centered. Wider screens
retain the existing 575-pixel logo width.

The interactive plot now recognizes native touch gestures:

* Drag with one finger to pan.
* Pinch with two fingers to zoom.
* Move both fingers together while pinching to pan and zoom around the moving midpoint.

Touch navigation uses the same cached/refined tile pipeline and 100-bp minimum viewport
as wheel, mouse, trackpad, and keyboard navigation. Desktop wheel zoom, mouse drag,
keyboard controls, double-click reset, and scientific behavior are unchanged.
